title: Cannonship
description:
I got a little plane. I call it Cannoship. I with my cannonship fight strange enemies to save the world
 

Overview:
Cannon ship is a classic shooter game but with modern touches! 
You must fight with huge number of enemies to save the world from annihilation. You don't seem to stand a chance, but by upgrade your ship you can destroy a bosses and many different enemies! 

Features:
- 8 different sceneries
- single player or local cooperation mode
- upgrade your airship
- achievements
- support for game controllers
- pixel art
- retro difficulty level

Cannonship is a game created by one person with only two hands :)
description_short: Cannonship is an action-packed shootout in which your plane must fight a horde of enemies. You can fight your opponents alone or with another player. Upgrade your ship and tip the balance of victory to your side! Will you accept the challenge?
